dict.string: Font Atlas reads font files on external drives you add to your library. Nothing is uploaded.
Font Atlas reads font files on network volumes you add to your library. Nothing is uploaded.
Font Atlas reads font files in a Desktop folder only if you add it to your library.
Font Atlas reads font files in a Documents folder only if you add it to your library.
Font Atlas reads font files in a Downloads folder only if you add it to your library.
Font Atlas reads font files stored in cloud folders (iCloud Drive, OneDrive) that you add to your library.
